summary: A three column record list of webhooks with no actions slot, so there is no trailing menu track.
use: Read-only lists such as webhook endpoints or logs where rows have facts but no per-row actions.
spec: 2 rows from `hooks`, each a `<RecordRow>` keyed by `hook.id`
`<RecordCell label="Events">` and `<RecordCell label="Delivered">` follow; the row has no actions snippet and `columns` has no trailing action track
